algorithms.direct_boolean: search_direct_boolean (all queries, with exclude for AND NOT)

parameters.schedule: shuffle all eligible (algorithm,query) blocks per repetition; fixed seed
parameters.synthetic_series_03: not remeasured; delivered 03_boolesche_mehrwortsuche stays as is

timer: time.perf_counter_ns; integer elapsed_ns per complete block
cache: prepared corpus and prechecked index reused; no cold-cache measurement; load includes OS cache effects

timing_boundaries.preparation: complete public prepare_corpus on already loaded raw documents
timing_boundaries.build: complete public build_inverted_index on prepared documents
timing_boundaries.query: complete public search including query and exclude normalization, posting gathering, stable length sort if applicable, merging, difference for AND NOT, full fresh result list
timing_boundaries.block: five complete identical calls retained then checked; previous results deleted before next timer
timing_boundaries.excluded: manifest/proposal checks, correctness, diagnostics, disk output and summary

statistics: median, inclusive Q1/Q3, IQR; one block is one sample; quartiles are not confidence intervals
memory: not measured; CSV index_bytes and peak_memory_bytes remain empty
real_corpus: BGB (daten/real/bgb/dokumente, 2486 paragraphs, one document each); delivered series 03 real part used the Kafka excerpt
